next.reason: 1985: 'the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available, even though'; 2023: 'is available, provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description'. 2023 keeps the rule, including the SAME RECORD AREA exception, but only guarantees identifier-1 stays available when it is not part of the file's own record descriptions. 1985 states no such proviso.
